sections.heading: Who We Are
sections.body:
The International Human Rights Council – USA (IHRC-USA) is an organization focused on human rights awareness, Research,Dignity, humanitarian values, peace, equality and community development.

IHRC-USA seeks to bring together individuals, volunteers, professionals, community leaders and organizations who share a commitment to human dignity and social responsibility.

Our approach emphasizes education, awareness, community participation, humanitarian service and constructive cooperation.

chairman-message.title: Chairman’s Message
chairman-message.subtitle: A message from the Chairman of IHRC-USA.

sections.heading: Dear Members, Volunteers, Partners, and Human Rights Defenders,
sections.body:
It is my great honor to present the International Human Rights Council – USA (IHRC-USA).

Human rights are the foundation of a peaceful, fair, and sustainable world. Every individual, regardless of nationality, race, gender, religion, social status, or background, deserves respect, dignity, equality, and justice.

IHRC-USA is committed to promoting and protecting fundamental human rights through awareness, education, humanitarian service, community empowerment, and international cooperation.

Our mission is guided by the principles of universal justice, compassion, integrity, accountability, and respect for human dignity.

Through the dedication of our members and partners around the world, we continue working toward a society where every person has the opportunity to live with freedom, safety, equality, and hope.

This handbook serves as a guiding document for our organization, explaining our vision, mission, values, responsibilities, and commitment to human rights principles.

I invite everyone to join hands with IHRC-USA in building a world based on peace, justice, equality, and humanity.

Together, we can create meaningful change.

sections.heading: With respect and commitment,
sections.body:
Chairman
International Human Rights Council – USA (IHRC-USA)
“Equal Justice for Everyone & Everywhere”

vision-mission.title: Vision & Mission
vision-mission.subtitle: What we aspire to and how we work towards it.

sections.heading: Our Vision
sections.body:
“A world where every person enjoys dignity, equality, freedom, justice and peace.”

Our vision is an inclusive society in which everyone is responsible for promoting and protecting human rights; everyone is respected and treated with equal dignity and respect; and the human rights of all are a reality, and a world in which human rights are universally recognized, respected, and protected.

We envision a society in which justice is upheld and every individual is empowered to live a life of dignity, freedom, and equality. We conduct research and take action to prevent and end human rights abuses, and to promote the values enshrined in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and other internationally agreed human rights standards.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.body:
“To promote human-rights awareness, humanitarian values, peace, equality and community empowerment through education, advocacy, service, partnerships and responsible action.”

Our mission is to promote and protect the fundamental rights and freedoms of all individuals, regardless of race, gender, color, religion, language, or socio-economic status. We strive to create a society in which the rights of every person are upheld, respected, and protected without prejudice or discrimination.

Addressing the root causes of inequality, discrimination and injustice by changing laws, policies, practices and cultures. We do this through education, research, advocacy, investigation and monitoring.

We act as a driver for social change based on substantive equality principles. We fulfill our mission by exposing, challenging, and ending entrenched and pervasive structures and systems of discrimination through education, policy development, public inquiries, and litigation.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.subtitle: How IHRC-USA collects, uses and protects your information.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you give us when you apply for membership, volunteer, contact us, verify a member or make a financial contribution. This may include your name, email address, phone number, address and any details you choose to share.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: Your information is used to process membership applications, respond to enquiries, organise programs and events, send updates you have asked for, and meet our legal and reporting obligations.

sections.heading: Sharing of Information
sections.body: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We share it only with trusted service providers who help us run the website and our programs, or where disclosure is required by law.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This website may use essential cookies to work properly. We do not use cookies to track you across other websites.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We take reasonable steps to protect your information from loss, misuse and unauthorised access. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You may ask to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, or withdraw your consent to receive communications, at any time.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this policy can be sent via the Contact page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: The terms that apply when you use this website.

sections.heading: Acceptance
sections.body: By accessing or using this website you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use the website.

sections.heading: Use of Content
sections.body: Content on this website is provided for information about our work and programs. You may not copy, modify or distribute it for commercial purposes without written permission.

sections.heading: Membership and Verification
sections.body: Membership applications are subject to review and approval. Member IDs and certificates remain the property of the organisation and must not be misused or transferred.

sections.heading: Financial contributions
sections.body: Financial contributions are voluntary and support our programs. Refunds are handled as described in our Refund Policy.

sections.heading: User Conduct
sections.body: You agree not to misuse the website, submit false information, or attempt to disrupt its operation or security.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: We make every effort to keep information accurate but provide the website as is, without warranties of any kind.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the website means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms can be sent via the Contact page.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.subtitle: How refunds work for financial contributions and membership fees.

sections.heading: Financial contributions
sections.body: Financial contributions are voluntary contributions that fund our work and are generally non-refundable. If you made a financial contribution by mistake or were charged an incorrect amount, contact us within 14 days and we will review your request.

sections.heading: Membership Fees
sections.body: Membership fees are non-refundable once a membership has been approved and a Member ID issued. If your application is declined, any fee paid will be refunded in full.

sections.heading: Events and Programs
sections.body: If we cancel an event or program for which you paid a fee, you will receive a full refund or the option to transfer to a future date.

sections.heading: How to Request a Refund
sections.body: Send your request through the Contact page with your name, the date and amount of the payment, and the reason for the request. Please allow up to 14 working days for us to respond.

sections.heading: Processing Time
sections.body: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method. Your bank or payment provider may take additional days to show the refund.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this policy can be sent via the Contact page.

disclaimer.title: Official Disclaimer
disclaimer.subtitle: Please read this notice before using the website.

sections.heading: General Information
sections.body: The information on this website is provided by the IHRC-USA for general information and human rights awareness only. It is not legal advice and is not a substitute for advice from a qualified legal professional.

sections.heading: Accuracy
sections.body: We make reasonable efforts to keep the content accurate and up to date, but we do not guarantee that all information is complete or current. Content may be changed or removed without notice.

sections.heading: External Links
sections.body: This website may link to external websites. IHRC-USA is not responsible for the content or practices of those websites.

sections.heading: Use of Name and Logo
sections.body: The IHRC name and logo may not be used without written permission. Membership, positions and authority within IHRC can be confirmed only through official IHRC channels.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this notice can be sent to info@ihrc-usa.org.

Members Restrictions & Regulations
lines: 1. No Financial Fundraising: Members are strictly prohibited from collecting or soliciting financial financial contributions under the IHRC-USA name without explicit, written authorization from the SLK Headquarters.
2. No Official Representation: No Members may act, speak, or issue statements to the media as an official international representative of the IHRC-USA without a formal mandate.

3. Non-Compensated Service: All Members positions are strictly unpaid. The IHRC-USA does not provide salaries, and the headquarters is not responsible for personal expenses incurred during Members work.

4. IHRC-USA ID Card Policy: Issued digital or physical Members cards remain the intellectual property of the organization. Misuse, forgery, or public leaks of these documents will lead to immediate termination.
5. Strict Neutrality: In compliance with non-profit standards, Members must remain completely non-partisan. You cannot endorse political parties or candidates using the IHRC-USA affiliation.

6. Content Monitoring: All content posted by Members on the organization’s network is heavily monitored. Individual accounts will be suspended if posts conflict with the core values of the IHRC-USA Headquarters.
